headline: 34 killed as coal mine explosion rocks southern Pakistan
summary: A suspected methane gas blast tore through a mine in Balochistan, killing dozens of workers and leaving others trapped underground.
details: At least 34 workers have been killed following a massive explosion at a coal mine in southern Pakistan. The blast occurred on Thursday near the capital of the resource-rich province of Balochistan.
The provincial disaster management authority reported that 34 bodies have been recovered so far, while rescue operations continue to locate other trapped miners.
Authorities suspect that a buildup of methane gas caused the explosion. The blast was so powerful that it tore through the mine, sparking a rescue operation that lasted throughout the night.
Tragedy struck twice as some miners rushed into the mine immediately after the blast to rescue their colleagues, only to be killed themselves.
The incident took place in Sorange, approximately 50 kilometers from the provincial capital, Quetta. Relatives and rescue teams spent hours ferrying soot-covered bodies out of the concrete tunnels.
Mining accidents are frequent in Balochistan, a province that is Pakistan's largest by landmass and rich in coal, gold, and copper, but often lags in safety standards and economic development.

headline_marked: 3 killed, 20+ injured in [[bus-truck collision in Tangail]]
headline: 3 killed, 20+ injured in bus-truck collision in Tangail
summary: A head-on collision in Madhupur upazila left three dead and over 20 passengers injured last night.
details: At least three people were killed and more than 20 others were injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a truck in Tangail’s Madhupur upazila last night.
According to Madhupur Fire Service Team Leader Borhan Ali, all the deceased and injured were passengers on the bus.
The accident occurred around 10:00 pm in the Raktipara area. Fire service personnel and locals worked together to rescue the victims from the wreckage.
The bodies of the three deceased have been kept at the hospital, while police are working to identify them.
Eight of the injured are currently being treated at Madhupur Upazila Health Complex.
Several critically injured victims have been referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital and other healthcare facilities for advanced treatment.
